messages:
liz: Legal/Customer ask: MicroBank is requesting a hard freeze on model v3.2 for their production route during an upcoming compliance review. They want a contractual guarantee + migration assistance. Can product triage?

devin: Do they mean immutable artifact (no model binary changes) or pinning at routing level?

liz: They want both: no model code/weights updates and route pinned to v3.2. Duration = 45 days after audit, with possible 30d extension. They may pay for reserved capacity.

priya: Heads-up: v3.2 uses custom post-processing script (normalizer vA). Our standard v4.0 removed that and normalizes differently. Migration delta on our NLU tests ~3.8% intent precision drop if we swap. Compat shim needed.
jordan: Operational impact: pinned route -> dedicated artifact + avoid auto-rollouts. Needs KV persistence testing and snapshotting. Ops cost estimate depends on retention window; rough: 0.4-0.8 GPU-months and 6-12 hours initial runbook.
olga: Sales note: customer willing to sign amendment if we provide a migration credit (1 month free) and SLA for pin availability. Also require 24/7 on-call during audit window.

anika: Legal: we'll need an addendum: termination conditions, liability cap for pinned behavior, data handling obligations, and a minimum 30d deprecation notice after pin. Also clarify who is responsible for security patches (we normally push critical fixes but pinned customers may need to accept a patch or an emergency migration).

devin: Product suggestion: offer two lanes: "Frozen Pin" (contracted, paid, no auto-updates, emergency patch policy) or "Guarded Route" (pin at routing level but fallback allowed under latency/cost/regression alarms). Price difference and ops coverage differ.

priya: For acceptance gates for a freeze: we require benchmark run pre-freeze:
- latency p95 <= 400ms on their production footprint
- token cost delta <= +12% vs baseline
- behavioral similarity (BLEU/ROUGE-style or embedding sim) >= 94% across their golden prompts
- hallucination regression <1.5%
I'll publish the eval sheet to the shared drive.

jordan: If product agrees, ops needs a ticket with: artifact hash, pinned route config, expected RPS, and retention policy. I can template this.

olga: Customer asks for a canary for 48h before lock, but they want it at 0% change tolerance. Maybe we negotiate a 1% canary that runs only for health checks.

anika: Also require an explicit audit log export contract for the 45-day window. Security will validate logging access.

liz: OK action items I'm proposing: 1) Product to finalize two-lane offering + pricing; 2) Eng to create compat shim plan and estimate effort; 3) Ops to template pin ticket and cost; 4) Legal to draft addendum; 5) DM customer with expected timeline. Agree?

devin: +1 for two-lane approach. Recommend adding a migration playbook with rollback steps and a list of golden prompts the customer must agree to run during the audit.

priya: Estimate for compat shim: 2 engineer-weeks if no model retrain, else longer. Will draft technical spec and include eval script.
jordan: Ops: I'll create INF ticket and add a monitoring runbook, include alert thresholds for drift > 2.5% and p95 breaches.
olga: I'll draft commercial terms and include 1-month migration credit option.
anika: I'll start the addendum draft and send to liz for redlines.

ops-bot: INF-4401 created by jordan: Pinned-route template and monitoring runbook scheduled

liz: Thanks team. I'll reply to MicroBank with the two-lane proposal and ask for their golden prompt set. Planning kickoff Tuesday.

ops-bot: calendar-event scheduled for 1723543200: "MicroBank freeze kickoff" by liz
